content:
Horsehead Corporation is a prominent American chemical company with a rich history in the production of specialty materials, particularly in the field of zinc and specialty chemicals. Located at 300 Frankfort Road, Monaca, PA 15061-2295, the company has long played a vital role in the regional and national industrial landscape, contributing to advancements in sustainable materials and resource recovery processes. Established with a focus on innovative metallurgical technologies, Horsehead has specialized in the recycling of electric arc furnace (EAF) dust—a byproduct of steel production—into high-purity zinc metal and other valuable industrial products. This proprietary recycling process not only supports the circular economy but also reduces environmental impact by diverting hazardous waste from landfills and enabling the recovery of critical resources.

Over the years, Horsehead Corporation has evolved to meet changing market demands and environmental regulations, demonstrating resilience in the face of industry shifts. The Monaca facility has been central to the company’s operations, serving as a hub for research, development, and large-scale production. Although Horsehead filed for bankruptcy in recent years and underwent restructuring, its legacy in pioneering zinc recovery and sustainable chemical manufacturing endures. The site continues to represent an important nexus of innovation, environmental responsibility, and industrial capability in western Pennsylvania, contributing to the broader goals of clean technology and resource efficiency in the 21st-century manufacturing sector.
